outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Areas of Practice page
outreach_draft.body:
Amy,

I was looking through Owen Law Firm’s site and noticed Personal Injury and Civil Rights are both explained on the same Areas of Practice page rather than having their own dedicated client pages.

Those are very different conversations. Someone dealing with a serious civil-rights violation is arriving with questions about discrimination, evidence, government or institutional conduct, and what to do next—not the same mindset as someone coming in after an accident.

A dedicated Civil Rights page could speak directly to that person, give Google a focused page to crawl and index, and give AI tools clearer context around that part of your practice.

I’m using Civil Rights as the first mockup because the contrast with Personal Injury makes the idea easy to see while keeping the brand intact.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
